title: Paul wrote to clergy to instill humility
english: In this letter Paul writes to clergy, not laity. For this reason he did not need to mention many wrongdoings. His aim through the letter was for humility to be set right in them. By the exhortation itself he shows the exactness of their other life. For rarely does someone both sin and become proud. Pride touches those who live most nobly and who, for this very reason, are usually lifted up.
Everywhere and through all things Paul shows that his sufferings and his defenses are not without profit. From your faith I make proof of your steadfastness.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Fragmenta in epistulam ad Philippenses u01-open
orientation: Severianus begins his commentary by explaining the audience and purpose of Paul's Letter to the Philippians.
